items.topic: Using Codex to reduce CI load by selecting tests
items.text:
Same. @useblacksmith has been an amazing sponsor but we need to distribute the load.

My plan is to let codex decide which tests actually need to run and drastically nix CI and run tests hourly.

quote_tweet.text: CI has become the top bottleneck of every engineering team I talk to (including Lindy). Our CI spend has become stratospheric.
